subject.title: Track OpenClaw seams needed for full imported-plugin parity

question: Which, if any, of these imported-plugin parity seams should become supported public OpenClaw SDK contracts, and what security and compatibility boundary should each contract preserve?
rationale: The issue proposes new cross-cutting public APIs and policy behavior rather than repairing an established contract, so source inspection alone cannot select the permanent product boundary or rollout order.

options.title: Stage a narrow public-contract roadmap
options.body: Prioritize one concrete seam at a time, with an explicit host-owned authorization and compatibility contract before Babelfish maps it.

options.title: Keep seams internal for now
options.body: Retain the current unsupported mappings until OpenClaw has a broader plugin-platform roadmap and owners for these contracts.

options.title: Delegate only marketplace parity first
options.body: Define a narrowly scoped delegation interface for bundle installation and lifecycle while leaving approval, connector, and agent-profile APIs internal.

recommendation.title: Stage a narrow public-contract roadmap
recommendation.body: Prioritize one concrete seam at a time, with an explicit host-owned authorization and compatibility contract before Babelfish maps it.
